text:
olivia chen: Quick request from onboarding: can we add a small "copybox" to Dedicated autoscale docs — short explainer + copy-paste YAML + SDK + tiny migration map?
diego ramos: I can do a compact version. plan: 1-sentence, 8-line YAML, 4-line python SDK, 2-line terraform, 3-line migration map.
lina m.: Please include two short operational callouts: min_replicas=0 => cold start; burst_enabled without reserved pool => not SLA-backed.
kevin z.: +1. Also align field names to SDK v2 (qps_target -> target_qps_per_replica).
diego ramos: Draft below (kept minimal so it's copy-paste ready):
```yaml
# quickcopy autoscale policy
name: api-lowlat
min_replicas: 1
max_replicas: 6
burst_enabled: true
target_qps_per_replica: 120
preemption_policy: standard
```
(one-line: minimal autoscale policy for low-latency frontends)
```python
# python SDK minimal
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
pol = c.create_autoscale_policy(name="api-lowlat", min_replicas=1, max_replicas=6, burst_enabled=True, target_qps_per_replica=120)
print(pol.id)
```
```hcl
# terraform minimal (inline)
resource "redwood_autoscale_policy" "api" { name = "api-lowlat" min_replicas = 1 }
```
Migration map (v1 -> v2):
- qps_target -> target_qps_per_replica
- priority -> preemption_policy
- enable_burst -> burst_enabled

lina m.: Added the two operational bullets under the example as requested:
- operational: min_replicas=0 => expect cold start latency on first requests
- SLA note: burst capacity is not SLA-backed unless using reserved pools (see provisioning glossary)
diego ramos: Will open a small PR with the snippets + add the quickcopy box in the right-hand docs layout. I'll link infra terraform examples instead of copying full TF code.
docs-bot: Reminder: check the "Examples" box in the docs PR template and include a fixtures test under examples/fixtures.
kevin z.: reviewing the PR once opened. prefer to keep "preemption_policy: standard" and a single-line explanation: "controls eviction severity". small nit.
diego ramos: noted and adjusted in draft. opening PR now and tagging @olivia for a quick OK.
olivia chen: thank you — if it's tiny I'll merge after one lgtm. appreciate the quick turnaround.
